mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log (actor_id, actor_role, action, target, ip) VALUES (#{actorId}, #{actorRole}, #{action}, #{target}, #{ip}::inet)
mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.actor_id, l.actor_role, l.action, l.target, host(l.ip) AS ip, l.created_at, a.name AS actor_name FROM audit_log l LEFT JOIN account a ON a.id = l.actor_id ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
